CustomField.description: Optional. The module's classes Core builds by name for its extension seams, one per line as Seam: Class (for example NightlyStepProvider: followed by the module's provider class), the seam being the Core interface the class implements. Core asks the modules in catalog order; a class that is not installed is skipped (ModuleExtensions, ADR-0017 as extended by D-200 S1).
CustomField.label: Extensions
